meta.purpose: The places of Guneku, in one structure, so a map can be drawn from the record rather than from memory. Each entry carries where its position came from and how precise that is — or says plainly that no position is recorded.
meta.coordinateRule: A coordinate is published only where a source gives one. Nothing here is estimated, interpolated from a neighbouring place, or read off a picture of a map. A place with no recorded position appears in the list with `coordinate: null` and is NOT drawn on the map: an approximate pin on a village map is not a smaller truth than a missing one, it is a different and false claim about where something is.
meta.state: For now the map shows one marker: Guneku itself, from an older village map link rather than a survey. The other places below — the Palace, the health centres, the markets, the river, the projects — will be added as we confirm exactly where each one stands.
meta.attribution: Map tiles and base geography: © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. Rendered with MapLibre GL JS. No Google Maps imagery is used, re-hosted or traced (R-010).

locations.name: Guneku
locations.precisionNote: A single point standing for the whole village, not its boundary or surveyed centre.
locations.description: Guneku lies in Mbengwi Subdivision, Momo Division, in the North West Region of Cameroon, reachable by road from Mbengwi and from Bamenda. It shares boundaries with Mbemi, Nyen, Tugi, Zang-Tembeng, Oshie, Mundum and Bafut.

locations.name: The Guneku Palace
locations.reason: No source in the Fondom's records gives the Palace a coordinate.
locations.description: The seat of HRH Fon Fomuki Walters Ticha IX and of the Guneku Traditional Council.

locations.name: Munam Integrated Health Centre
locations.reason: The record places it in the Munam quarter and describes its condition, but gives no coordinate.
locations.description: A government structure offering general consultations. Operational, and took an additional GUDECA-funded nurse in 2020.

locations.name: Open Door Medical Clinic
locations.reason: The record names Njinebai as its location. Njinebai is not on the Fondom's 27-quarter list (R-028), and no coordinate is recorded.

locations.name: The market at Ngong
locations.reason: The 2016 AGM proposals refer to "the existing Ngong market" but give no position.
locations.description: A market of its own in the Ngong quarter, distinct from Ngon — the name of the village market day.

locations.name: The proposed daily market at Windig
locations.reason: Proposed in the record; no position given, and the market itself is a proposal rather than a place that exists.
locations.description: HRH Fon Fomuki proposed the creation of a daily market at Windig to ease the sale of farm produce.

locations.name: The River Batmuki
locations.reason: A river is a line, not a point, and no course or trace is recorded. Drawing one from the description would be inventing geography.
locations.description: Runs through the village from upper Guneku and joins the Mezam River. Youths of Guneku and neighbouring villages take sand from it.

locations.name: The stream at Ngong
locations.description: The stream where a child was rescued in June 2026, and the water shortage behind that story.

locations.name: Guneku Royal Community Library
locations.description: Our solar-powered community library, with computers and training for pupils and students.

locations.name: Guneku Agro CIG
locations.reason: The register places it at Ngong Quarter but gives no coordinate.
locations.description: Community-owned agricultural enterprise at Ngong Quarter.

locations.name: The Tonmukom–Windik road
locations.reason: A road is a line between two points, and neither endpoint has a recorded coordinate.
locations.description: Road work through Guneku, with photographs in our gallery.

locations.name: The GUYODECA bridges
locations.reason: No position recorded for any of the bridges.
locations.description: Bridge construction by GUYODECA, our youth association.

locations.name: The FUN electricity project
locations.description: GUDECA Europe contributed toward the FUN electricity project in 2025.

omitted.what: The 27 quarters as map areas or pins
omitted.why: We do not yet have the boundaries or positions of our quarters, and we will not guess them. All twenty-seven are on the quarters page.
We are still confirming how many schools Guneku has and where each one stands. They will be added when we are sure.
Guneku has many churches — one survey counted nineteen — and they will be placed once we know exactly where each stands.

omitted.what: Caves, waterfalls, mountains, hills and springs
omitted.why: Our caves, mountains, waterfalls, hills and springs are many, but we have not yet named and placed them individually. If you can, help us.
